summary.en: Items: 10,000 Yen Bills Culprits: Bella Hikifune, Masaya Tatsumi, and Bella's henchmen In Japan, Bella's mafioso group had been falsificating paper money from Japan and trying to make them circulate. After their plan had failed, they tried to retrieve them back to Italy to evitate japanese justice but some were leaked out by Tatsumi which is why Bella is still in Tokyo, Japan searching for them. Robbed item: 10,000 Yen bill The Detective Boys were in one of Beika's neighborhood eating and saw an old lady lose a bill which was taken over by the wind. It then pushed it to the park where Bella was and she took it while retrieving the other counterfeits that Tatsumi spilled there which was witnessed by the detective boys who started to chase after them. Victims: Ai Haibara, Ayumi Yoshida, Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya, Genta Kojima, and Masaya Tatsumi Culprits: Bella Hikifune and her henchmen After chasing Bella who was retrieving her bills in the park, the Detective Boys (without Conan) arrive to a dead end where they were caught by Bella and her henchmen who drugged them to make them sleep. Earlier, Tatsumi had been running after leaking out some of the bills he fabricated so he could pay his debts and get some orange juice but was cornered in a container and drugged by the mafiosos who also put the kids inside.
